title: Настя спасает черепаху  (Nastya Rescues the Turtle)

segments.t: Horrified that the kitchen is about to turn a live turtle into soup, vegetarian Nastya pleads with Fedya to spare the animal and give it to her instead. Softening under her gaze, Fedya hands the turtle over and promises to trick the guest with chicken marinated in fish stock.
То есть вместо нее умрет курица?
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
'Are you not going to cook her?' Notice how Russian expresses 'not' and 'to cook' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Max answers right away.
'Not right now.' The meaning hinges on 'not' working together with 'will' in spoken Russian.
'I am going to cook her tomorrow.' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'will' without extra filler words.
'Will you give her to me?' Max raises the pitch on 'for me' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Fedya answers right away.
'I am begging you.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'beg' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Do not look at me like that.' Max brings out the contrast between 'not' and 'look' in a few short words.
'Here, take her.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'on' and 'take' in a few short words. Max answers right away.
'But what about the soup?' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'soup' without extra filler words.
'Chicken marinated in fish broth.' Notice how Russian expresses 'chicken' and 'fish' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'They will never guess the difference.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'they' and finishing on 'to guess'. Fedya answers right away.

'So a chicken is going to die in her place?' The meaning hinges on 'then' working together with 'chicken' in spoken Russian.
'Watch out or I will take her back right now.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'will take'.
'All right, go on.' The grammar packs 'like this' and 'go' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
